plugin.name: Gun Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies gameplay field of view; larger is wider, up to 150 degrees across. Cutscenes, active zoom and unavailable camera state keep their native framing. Applies at once.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher and studio logo videos. The game's intro still plays. Needs a restart.
GameSpeed.description: Native timing value; the shipped default is 30. Lower values increase game speed and higher values decrease it. Zero leaves the native value unchanged. Restart required.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply at the next game frame. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, with their black bars. Fill enlarges them past the black bars around the picture until the picture fits the screen, without cutting anything off.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while focused. Release it when another window is active or this option is off. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes; fullscreen always pauses. Applies immediately.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Gun Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Gun Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
